"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Today's highly mobile work force requires portability of insurance coverage that can go with them from job to job.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Putting the patient at the center of policy decisions will increase choice and reduce costs while ensuring that services provide what Americans actually want.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for ending tax discrimination against the individual purchase of insurance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for allowing consumers to purchase insurance across State lines.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for promoting Health Savings Accounts and Health Reimbursement Accounts to be used for insurance premiums.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for encouraging the private sector to rate competing insurance plans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for ensuring that America's aging population has access to safe and affordable care.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Because seniors overwhelmingly desire to age at home, support for making home care a priority in public policy.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for ensuring that quality care is provided across the care continuum from home to nursing home to hospice.",
